title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.0
subtitle: Bind deformable objects with two vertex groups.

highlights.title: Vertex group attachments
highlights.description: Choose a target object, Vertex Group 1 on the source, and Vertex Group 2 on the target directly in Object Mode.

highlights.title: Explicit and stable
highlights.description: Bind once at the current positions. Animation and bake validation preserve the chosen vertex pairs instead of silently rebuilding them.

highlights.title: Fast validation
highlights.description: A spatial search handles large groups efficiently, while changed or missing groups produce a clear rebuild message.
